events.verdict: Harden (LAC) engages and disengages with Durant (PHX) off ball, but allows him to move freely.
Harden (LAC) initiates illegal contact to Durant's (PHX) lower body that affects his jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) firms up in a screening position in Gillespie's (PHX) path and does not deliver contact.
Plumlee (PHX) makes contact across Zubac's (LAC) arms and body, affecting his dunk attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) establishes himself in Bogdanovic's (LAC) path and does not deliver contact.
Zubac (LAC) briefly grasps Plumlee's (PHX) arm during the rebound.
Bogdanovic (LAC) rests a forearm against Durant's (PHX) body and does not affect his shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Durant (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Durant (PHX) moves forwards into Harden's (LAC) space, initiating illegal lower body contact as he returns to the floor during his jump shot attempt.
Plumlee (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in Harden's (LAC) path and does not deliver contact.
Plumlee (PHX) and Dunn (LAC) come together as Plumlee is cutting towards the basket and the contact between the two players is incidental.
Plumlee (PHX) briefly grasps Zubac's (LAC) arm during the throw-in, but releases and allows him to receive the pass.
Durant (PHX) cleanly blocks Zubac's (LAC) layup attempt.
Harden (LAC) legally contests Durant's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Leonard (LAC) cleanly deflects the ball away from Plumlee (PHX) during the rebound.
The ball is last touched by Leonard (LAC) prior to it going out of bounds.
Dunn (LAC) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
Booker (PHX) commits a take foul on Harden (LAC).
Richards (PHX) reaches in and any contact with Leonard's (LAC) arm during the shot attempt is marginal.
